scientific_question: What is the unique correct world-XYZ to upright agentview pixel projection contract for the installed LIBERO, robosuite, MuJoCo, and renderer pipeline?

frozen_upstream.transitive_ledger: The blocked upstream protocol transitively freezes C0-v2, C1-v2.1 candidates and scale, D13/D14/D15, WM-v2A/B/B.1/C-EJ, the structured-state and visual-target audits, and all prior results/checkpoints.

historical_block.old_validator: projected gripper point distance to the large natural robot segmentation mask
historical_block.interpretation: the new experiment changes the validator to a tight native site landmark; it does not relax, replace, or recompute the old gate

required: MuJoCo cam_xpos/cam_xmat and camera local-axis convention
robosuite IMAGE_CONVENTION and camera sensor slice

convention_semantics.direct_render: use raw robosuite utility floating (u,v) directly as an index into the direct upright RGB
convention_semantics.vertical_flip_to_direct_render: leave the direct RGB unchanged and convert only the projected coordinate with u_final=u_raw and v_final=H-1-v_raw
convention_semantics.selection_basis: source-level coordinate trace, frozen before landmark errors; no arbitrary u flip or extrinsic transpose is source-plausible

landmarks.inventory: enumerate every runtime site with ID, name, site properties, finite site_xpos, and native type-6 segmentation visibility on init31 for all tasks

primary_inclusion.rendered_reference: native MuJoCo element segmentation pixels with object type 6 and exact site ID

landmarks.single_type_rule: if gripper0_grip_site is the only qualifying primary landmark, repeated observations across ten tasks and init31-34 provide 40 independent planning-state checks

rasterization_tolerance.derivation: A floating projected center is compared with integer raster indices at 128x128. Nearest-pixel quantization contributes at most sqrt(0.5^2+0.5^2)=0.707 px under center sampling; integer-index versus center convention and segmentation-boundary discretization add at most about one pixel. The preregistered max is conservatively rounded to 2 px, with median 1 px and p95 1.5 px. Values were fixed before init32-34 comparison and are not fitted to downstream results.

gates.direct_rgb_orientation: all 40 direct renders bitwise equal observation RGB, max absolute difference 0, shape uint8[128,128,3]
gates.selected_rule: pooled and every task, landmark, and init-state group must pass the same absolute gate
gates.alternative_rule: every source-plausible alternative must fail the same pooled absolute gate; if more than one passes, verdict is PROJECTION_CONVENTION_AMBIGUOUS
gates.validity: all primary points finite, positive camera depth, in frame when the native site segmentation is visible

independent_projection.comparison: floating output and depth compared against robosuite transform before rounding/clipping

secondary_checks.historical_robot_mask: recompute full robot-mask point distances only as historical reproduction; never enters the new verdict
secondary_checks.relevant_object_center: project current relevant-object root-body center and report inside-own-mask, inside-visible-bbox, and distance-to-own-mask; body center is not point ground truth and remains secondary
secondary_checks.geom_footprint: skip with GEOM_FOOTPRINT_CHECK_NOT_IMPLEMENTED if safe primitive/mesh footprint rasterization would add implementation risk
